gencomp: Fit Spatial-Genetic Competition Models

Source: R/competition-package.R
gencomp-package.Rd

Fit spatial-genetic competition models for assessing the competition capacity of genotypes. Contained are functions used to build a competition matrix based on different criteria, fit the spatial-genetic competition model, and extract and visualize the results.
